name: Plagues
overview: Scripture reveals plagues as divine instruments used by God to demonstrate His unparalleled sovereignty and to execute righteous judgment upon sin, as seen when God declares He will send plagues to show that none is like Him on earth (Exodus 9:14). The severity of these judgments increases in response to persistent disobedience, with multiplied plagues brought according to sins (Leviticus 26:21). In the New Testament, plagues are associated with prophetic signs of the end times, including pestilences and fearful wonders from heaven (Luke 21:11), and are depicted as part of God's final wrath fulfilled through seven angels who wield these plagues with authority (Revelation 11:6; 15:1, 6). This underscores the seriousness of God's holiness and the ultimate accountability of humanity before Him.
